name: sedan_6mt
source: Plausible 6-speed manual transaxle for a 2.0 L front-drive sedan, NOT a specific gearbox. Ratios within the typical passenger-car range (1st 3.5-3.8, top 0.7-0.8, near-geometric progression; Naunheimer et al., Automotive Transmissions, 2nd ed., Springer 2011, ch. 3-4 - verify chapter before citing). Mesh efficiency 0.96-0.98 per gear (same source class). Synchro capacities are input-shaft-referred cone-synchro torques sized so a 1-2 upshift syncs in ~0.06 s; reverse has no synchro (it grinds if selected while rolling). Axis signs follow the mesh-reversal chain of a transverse transaxle (input +y, output -y). PHYS-033 I3.
